column1: #   name        unique row label (also the results/<name>.log basename)
#   image       Docker base image (a pristine, official distro — nothing pre-baked)
#   do_boot     1 = boot Chalie + wait for /ready 200; 0 = stop after the dependency audit
#   pass              installer succeeds, deps resolve, (and /ready 200 if do_boot=1)
#   refuse-old-python default python3 is < 3.11 → installer MUST refuse (correct behaviour)
#   gap               unhandled distro (installer has no apt/dnf branch) → failure is the
#                     documented expectation; UNEXPECTED-PASS means prebuilt wheels covered it
# apt path = Debian/Ubuntu · dnf path = Fedora/RHEL-family · everything else = gap.
